typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	A2C_CHANGEDMEMTAB_SQL as string (),
	A2C_MAINTAB_SQL as string (),
	A2C_NEWMEMTAB_SQL as string (),
	A2C_TERMMEMTAB_SQL as string (),
	EmailRecipients as string (),
	EmailSubject as string (),
	EndDate as string (),
	EndDateUsr as string (),
	ExportFileName as string (),
	ExportFolder as string (),
	ExportFolderFile as string (),
	FailureEmailNotification as string (),
	File_Prefix as string (),
	History_Id as integer (),
	OpenRowSet_Var as string (),
	SendEmail as integer (),
	StartDate as string (),
	StartDateUsr as string (),
	TemplateFile as string (),
	Template_FileName as string (),
	UPDATEDELTADATEIND as integer ()
}

source(output(
		SUBSCRIBER_ID as string,
		STATE_ID as string,
		FULL_NAME as string,
		DOB as date,
		CASE_ID as string,
		MEMBER_PHONE as string,
		MEMBER_EMAIL as string,
		SERVICECODE as string,
		SERVICE_STARTDATE as timestamp,
		SERVICE_ENDDATE as timestamp,
		PROVIDERNAME as string,
		BARRIERS as string,
		QUANTITY as string,
		POCEFFDATE as timestamp,
		SCOPEOFSUPPORTSTOBEPROVIDED as string,
		CARECOORDINATOR_NAME as string,
		CARECOORDINATOR_PHONE as string,
		CARECOORDINATOR_EMAIL as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT [SUBSCRIBER_ID],[STATE_ID],[FULL_NAME],[DOB],[CASE_ID],[MEMBER_PHONE],[MEMBER_EMAIL],[SERVICECODE],[SERVICE_STARTDATE],[SERVICE_ENDDATE],[PROVIDERNAME],[BARRIERS],[QUANTITY],[POCEFFDATE],[SCOPEOFSUPPORTSTOBEPROVIDED],[CareCoordinator_Name],[CareCoordinator_Phone],[CareCoordinator_Email] FROM [EXTRACT].[ACCESS2CARE_STAGING]',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> ChangedTab
ChangedTab derive({Copy of SERVICECODE} = SERVICECODE,
		{Copy of SERVICE_ENDDATE} = toString(SERVICE_ENDDATE),
		{Copy of MEMBER_PHONE} = MEMBER_PHONE,
		{Copy of SUBSCRIBER_ID} = SUBSCRIBER_ID,
		{Copy of CARECOORDINATOR_PHONE} = CARECOORDINATOR_PHONE,
		{Copy of BARRIERS} = BARRIERS,
		{Copy of CARECOORDINATOR_NAME} = CARECOORDINATOR_NAME,
		{Copy of PROVIDERNAME} = PROVIDERNAME,
		{Copy of QUANTITY} = QUANTITY,
		{Copy of CASE_ID} = CASE_ID,
		{Copy of SCOPEOFSUPPORTSTOBEPROVIDED} = SCOPEOFSUPPORTSTOBEPROVIDED,
		{Copy of POCEFFDATE} = toString(POCEFFDATE),
		{Copy of DOB} = toString(DOB),
		{Copy of FULL_NAME} = FULL_NAME,
		{Copy of SERVICE_STARTDATE} = toString(SERVICE_STARTDATE),
		{Copy of STATE_ID} = STATE_ID,
		{Copy of CARECOORDINATOR_EMAIL} = CARECOORDINATOR_EMAIL,
		{Copy of MEMBER_EMAIL} = MEMBER_EMAIL) ~> DataConversion
